caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned horizontally in the center-right area of the composition, set against a plain, off-white or beige background. The object consists of a long, slender, stick-like component that extends to the left and appears metallic or dark gray in color, with a small loop or hook near its middle. Attached to the right end of this stick are two circular, disk-like forms; the foremost disk is solid and textured with shades of gray and brown, while the disk behind it is larger and features concentric circular bands in alternating tones of brown and gray. The circular forms are aligned such that the textured disk partially obscures the concentric one behind it. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to convey a realistic effect, and there is a faint handwritten signature or note in the lower right corner of the image.
